_about: Scope guardrail eval (CLAUDE.md rule 5): 40 must-refuse and 40 must-answer messages in Hausa and English, with tricky pairs (a verdict vs the plain figure). `versions` are what a voice note gives the guard: the transcript, its English and the raw hypotheses. Our own test questions only. Run: uv run python evals/guardrails/run.py
